MINI DIAMOND COLLECTION

530 MAD

Every Mood Deserves Its Own Expression of Luxury. The Mini Diamond Collection is a fragrance experience that evolves with you, revealing a different facet of your style and presence with every scent. It brings together six of IBRAQ’s distinguished creations: Nude Coral Diamond, Emerald Soul Diamond, Gray Pearl Diamond, White Regent Diamond, Black Carbon Diamond, and Purple Heart Diamond. Six fragrances, each with its own character and signature, ranging from understated elegance to captivating presence and alluring warmth. A collection that gives you the luxury of choice, so every mood can have its own scent, and every side of you can have its own expression. MINI DIAMOND COLLECTION (10 mL): Nude Coral Diamond Emerald Soul Diamond Gray Pearl Diamond White Regent Diamond Black Carbon Diamond Purple Heart Diamond
